briefing: This is {PATRON}, out of {HERE}. Pirates have the lane to our neighbour locked down tight, and it's bleeding this station dry.
Fly it. Fight through whatever's waiting. Dock on the far side, and you'll have proven the route's still open.
Do that, and you're paid in full. Fail, and the lane stays shut, and so does half our trade.

lane.arrive: Fly to {TARGET} through the pirates, and dock, for {PAY}
lane.success: Docked at {TARGET} — the lane holds, and {PAY} is yours
lane.fail: Never reached {TARGET} — the lane stays shut, and {PAY} slips away

dossier.lead: {PATRON} wants a word, once the commander returns to {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Word on the boards says {PATRON} at {WORLD} still needs a pilot for the pirate lane.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the lane's still waiting for someone with nerve.

dossier.news: Station traffic through {WORLD} stays thin, and {PATRON} is still hiring for the pirate lane.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander agreed to clear the pirate lane to {WORLD} for a station under siege.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the commander had broken the blockade and opened the way to {WORLD}.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the lane to {WORLD} remained shut, and the commander's word carried no weight.

lane.success: On day {DAY}, the commander fought through to {WORLD} and proved the lane still open.
lane.failed: On day {DAY}, the commander failed to reach {WORLD}, and the lane stayed in pirate hands.

dossier.title: Run the Gauntlet
